Name: New Year style furniture and interior of farmhouse
Author: Kyuya258369
Description:
[size=5]                                              [color=#ff0000]  [b]All my mods just upload to NEXUS.
                                              Please don't re-upload anywhere else
[/b][/color][/size][b][color=#ff0000]                                               [size=5]我的所有mod只上传在N网，请不要二次上传(包括整合)到其他任何地方。

[/size][/color][/b]Happy Chinese New Year! 

This is an interior of a farmhouse with a floral lantern night scene theme (including all levels of cottages) and a set of Chinese classical furniture in the festive style of the Chinese New Year.

[color=#00ffff][size=4][b]need[/b][/size][/color]
SMAPI CP AT GMCM (Recommended)

[color=#00ffff][size=4][b]install[/b][/size][/color]
1. Download and install the necessary prerequisites
2. Download the mod file, unzip it, and place it in the "mod" folder

[color=#00ffff][size=4][b]important[/b][/size][/color]
1. Existing archives may encounter some unknown issues, please try to use them in new archives.
2. Furniture can be purchased from Robin or taken directly with CJB.
3. Some furniture has different textures that can be replaced using AT.
4. You can change [b][color=#ff7700]the density of shadows and the degree of snow scenery[/color][/b] in the configuration menu. (Please refer to the picture for specific effects)
5.When the farmhouse is upgraded to level three, the baby crib can be directly selected from the configuration menu to enable or not.
6.After upgrading the cellar, the entrance to the cellar will appear[color=#ff7700][b] below the stairs[/b][/color] on the first floor.
7. The kitchen has enabled matching textures by default, and you can choose whether to enable them in the configuration menu.
8.When the farmhouse is upgraded to level three, a unique BGM will be played every day from [color=#ff7700][b]8:00 to 12:00[/b][/color] and from [b][color=#ff7700]19:00 to 22:00[/color][/b] when entering the farmhouse.

[b][color=#00ffff][size=4]Known issues[/size][/color][/b]
1. After starting a new save, the initial furniture position is misplaced, and you need to retrieve the furniture yourself and use the [b][color=#ff7700][size=2]through wall mod[/size][/color][/b] to open the seed pack.
2. After upgrading the house each time, the furniture position may become messy, so it is best to recycle all the furniture before the upgrade is completed.
3. All spouse rooms have been cleared and wallpaper, flooring, and furniture can be freely replaced. But please note that every time you [color=#ff7700][b]leave the farmhouse[/b][/color] or [b][color=#ff7700]enter the next day[/color][/b], the wallpaper and flooring will return to their default state(but you can replace them again).
4. All maps have lights set at night, but [color=#ff7700][b]after marriage[/b][/color], these lights will disappear and the map will become pitch black. You can manually re light the map using the tool lights in the optional file.
5. All renovated rooms have been emptied, please [color=#ff7700][b]do not[/b][/color] ask Robin to build these rooms again. (Including baby crib, which can be directly set in the configuration menu)

This is my first time making a map, I hope you have fun: D！

这里是一套花灯夜景主题的农舍内部（包含所有等级的农舍）和一套新春喜庆风格的中式古典家具。

[b][color=#00ffff][size=4]需要[/size][/color][/b]
SMAPI CP AT GMCM（推荐）

[b][color=#00ffff][size=4]安装[/size][/color][/b]
1.下载并安装好所需前置
2.下载好本模组文件，将其解压后放入"mod"文件夹

[b][color=#00ffff][size=4]重要[/size][/color][/b]
1.已有的存档可能会出现一些未知问题，请尽量在新存档使用。
2.家具可以在罗宾那里购买，或者直接用CJB拿取。
3.部分家具有不同的纹理，可以使用AT进行更换。
4.可以在配置菜单中更改[b][color=#ff7700]阴影的浓度和雪景程度[/color][/b]。（具体效果请看图片）
5.当农舍升级为三级后，婴儿床可以直接在配置菜单中选择是否启用。
6.当升级地窖后，地窖入口会出现在一楼的[color=#ff7700][b]楼梯下方[/b][/color]。
7.厨房默认启用了配套的纹理，可以在配置菜单中选择是否启用。
8.当农舍升级到三级后，每天[color=#ff7700][b]8点到12点[/b][/color]，[color=#ff7700][b]19点到22点[/b][/color]这两个时间段进入农舍，会播放独特的bgm。

[b][color=#00ffff][size=4]已知问题[/size][/color][/b]
1.开始新存档后初始家具位置是错乱的，需要自己将家具收回，并使用穿墙mod去开启种子包。
2.每次升级房屋后家具位置会变乱，所以在升级完成前最好把全部家具回收。
3.所有配偶房已经被清空，可以自由更换壁纸地板和家具。但请注意，每当你[color=#ff7700][b]离开农舍[/b][/color]或者[color=#ff7700][b]进入下一天[/b][/color]后，壁纸和地板会变回默认的状态(但是可以重新换)。
4.所有地图在夜晚均设置了灯光，但在[color=#ff7700][b]结婚后[/b][/color]，这些灯光都会消失地图会变得漆黑一片。你可以使用可选文件中的工具灯为地图重新手动点上灯光。
5.所有的翻新房间均已清空，请[b][color=#ff7700]不要[/color][/b]再找罗宾去修建这些房间。（包括婴儿床，婴儿床可以直接在配置菜单进行设置）

这是我第一次制作地图，希望你能玩得开心:D！
